name: Java and Madura
locator: Printed p. 2 (PDF p. 23), II.I.A, Java en Madoera 1896 aggregate and notes 1–2.
definition: Civilian tables of the Java and Madura residencies, including Djokjokarta and Soerakarta within the aggregate. Includes adjacent islands assigned to those residencies. Excludes Buitenbezittingen, including Bali and Lombok, and army and navy personnel. The Inlanders column is the contemporary administrative figure for indigenous residents. Its completeness is unknown.
